items.title: Skill Trigger Surface
items.intent: The workstation should be discoverable from English user prompts.
reasons: SKILL metadata includes English trigger phrases.

items.title: Protocol Encyclopedia
items.intent: RootNet, WorkNet, staking, DAO, recipient, and endpoint knowledge should be captured locally.
reasons: Protocol core, staking, DAO, facts, and evidence are all present locally.

items.title: WorkNet Coverage
items.intent: Mine, Predict, KYA, Ardi, Gov, TMR, and Community should all be represented.
reasons: All named WorkNets have local dossiers, including the thinner TMR and Community entries.

items.title: Active WorkNet Source Depth
items.intent: Active WorkNets should not be treated as fully documented if the public source surface is still only a live ID plus a thin repo landing page.
reasons: Some active WorkNets are still represented mainly by live IDs plus thin repo surfaces, so the encyclopedia should not treat them as fully documented yet.

items.title: Glossary Coverage
items.intent: Key terms from the goal such as RootNet, WorkNet, skillURI, epoch, CLOB, and staking must be explainable.
reasons: Required AWP terms are defined in the generated glossary.

items.title: Concept Workflow Layer
items.intent: Cross-worknet concepts such as registration, recipient routing, delegation, qualification, settlement, Gov signing, and Ardi command guidance should be first-class encyclopedia records.
reasons: Cross-worknet concept/workflow records now cover registration, routing, delegation, qualification, settlement, Gov signing, and Ardi command guidance.
Concepts still marked thin: recipient-routing, allocation-and-delegation, qualification-gates, epoch-settlement, worknet-launch-lifecycle

items.title: Official Guide Depth
items.intent: Official onboarding and plain-language AWP guides should be tracked as first-class sources, facts, and concepts instead of only being implied by top-level indexes.
reasons: Official AWP onboarding and explanatory guides are tracked as distinct source records, fact bundles, and encyclopedia concepts.

items.title: Public Status Surfaces
items.intent: Official public lookup and status surfaces should be modeled distinctly from execution runtimes so the encyclopedia can explain what is safe to inspect versus what can actually act.
reasons: Official public lookup and status surfaces are represented distinctly from execution runtimes, including agent status, testnet activity, live RPC, Gov markets, and the whitepaper landing page.

items.title: Source Traceability
items.intent: Derived claims should link back to official source keys, locators, and stability labels.
reasons: Derived claims map to official source keys, locators, evidence types, and stability labels.

items.title: Registration Flow
items.intent: The workstation should understand and eventually execute awp-skill gasless registration.
reasons: The workstation now probes runtime and emits install/register commands, but full registration execution still depends on awp-skill availability.
Available registration-plan commands: ensure awp-skill dependency

items.title: Live RPC Scan
items.intent: The workstation should know the AWP RPC methods and report when live access is unavailable.
reasons: RPC methods are documented and modeled, but current environment still falls back to catalog mode.

items.title: Skill Inspector
items.intent: Official worknet skills should have install, preflight, and dry-run guidance even before the runtime is locally installed.
reasons: Predict, Gov, and Ardi expose runtime-specific install/inspection guidance.

items.title: Recovery State
items.intent: The workstation should persist and restore playbooks, runs, and pending confirmations.
reasons: Run state and confirmation queue files exist and are reused by preflight/review.

items.title: Live Canonical Quality
items.intent: Live WorkNet entries should resolve to canonical IDs and official skills with clear confidence.
reasons: No cached live worknet snapshot is available yet.

items.title: Upstream Drift Watch
items.intent: Official docs and skill sources should be refreshable and diffable so workstation knowledge can track upstream changes.
reasons: No official source snapshot exists yet.
